body:
## Why

Track D4 verification of merged PR #35 found substantive implementation for issue #32, but the issue-mandated deliberate-break demonstration is absent from the PR body. The merged change at `src/deliverable_render/store/validate.py` and named regression in `tests/store/test_communication_render_profile.py` are present on `main`; the missing behavior is durable red/green evidence proving that the regression test detects removal of the duplicate-document scan.

## Scope

Add one short verification document for issue #32. Preserve the merged implementation and tests unchanged.

## Tasks

- [ ] Create `docs/verification/issue-32-duplicate-scan-deliberate-break.md` containing the exact `python3 -m pytest tests/store/test_communication_render_profile.py::test_validator_rejects_duplicate_document_identity -q --no-cov` command, the observed failure after temporarily removing the duplicate-document scan from `src/deliverable_render/store/validate.py`, and the observed pass after reverting that mutation.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] On the exact `origin/main` baseline, `python3 -m pytest tests/store/test_communication_render_profile.py::test_validator_rejects_duplicate_document_identity -q --no-cov` passes and the document records the baseline commit.
- [ ] Deliberate-break proof: temporarily remove the duplicate-document scan in `src/deliverable_render/store/validate.py`; the named pytest node fails for the documented reason; revert the mutation; the same node passes.
- [ ] `git diff --exit-code HEAD -- src/deliverable_render/store/validate.py` passes after the revert, and that cleanup evidence is captured in `docs/verification/issue-32-duplicate-scan-deliberate-break.md`.

## Non-Goals

- Do not rework the already-merged duplicate-document implementation or change adjacent store validation behavior.
- Scaffold-only completion does NOT count: a document without the observed failing and passing named-test output does not satisfy this issue.

## Implementation Notes

PR #35 merged the implementation as `3e479ba4cfe652bf07ca6beea2df48c9caa10e46`. Keep the proof docs-only after reverting the temporary mutation.
